changes: Added the spend-matched A2-prime ablation arm + accurate token/wall-clock/agentCallCount accounting to the recovery runner (run-recovery.mjs records tokensSpent/wallClockMs/agentCallCount per pre-reg section 7 + a token+wall-clock spend-budget truncation mode, token binds first, hard-truncate; run-ablation.mjs computes A4 per-task median spend and runs A2-prime = a2prime bounded by 1.2x that median, recording per-run budgetPass requiring BOTH token AND wall-clock within plus-or-minus 20 percent). Added a no-LLM selfcheck (56 assertions).
usage: Run the ablation: A2-prime now spends token+wall-clock budget matched to A4 per-task median (not call count). Each run record carries tokensSpent/wallClockMs/agentCallCount/truncated; A2-prime jsonl carries budgetPass/tokenInBand/wallInBand. Verify offline: node experiments/recovery-runner/spend-accounting-selfcheck.mjs.
expectedOutcome: A2-prime is compute-matched to A4 on token+wall-clock spend per the locked pre-registration; budgetPass=true only when BOTH axes are within plus-or-minus 20 percent.
actualTranscript: selfcheck 56/56 assertions pass (no live LLM); genuine 2-host: 3 claude lanes PASS + codex host-2 round-1 BLOCK on budgetPass being token-only -> fixed (db47ecc7b) -> codex round-2 SHIP; 2 low quality findings + 1 high stale-evidence finding all resolved; full npm test green.
outcomeDiff: expected == actual: spend-match on token+wall-clock, both-band budgetPass, token-binds-first truncation, pre-reg section 7 field names.
limitations: A2-prime is a budget-match: a2prime stops at first acceptance pass, so on a passes-the-visible-test fault it may spend under budget (recorded via budgetPass under-match flag). The powered fault-bearing 24-task run is separate future work.
pitfalls: budgetPass MUST check both token AND wall-clock bands (a token-only check silently passes wall-clock out-of-tolerance runs — the host-2 round-1 finding). Cross-vendor review mattered: codex host-2 caught this; the 3 same-vendor lanes passed it.
